description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates a team member on a profile. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items/{teamMemberId} (JSON, partial update). Pass changed fields (name, email, description, calendarId, ...) via the `fields` passthrough. Path ids are never sent in the body.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

teamMemberId.description: The team member id to update (path only; required).

name: update_team_member
title: Update a team member
